title: Change Log Workflow Rules
subtitle: Revised 2026-10-22 (KW-66, KW-67; N. Wrana). Applies to Claude (chat), Claude Code, KelpWorks and people editing in Excel. Written from docs/backlog/workflow-rules.json by changelog_write.py --rules-sheet: change it there.

sections.heading: 1. Where the change log lives
rows: Master
C:\KelpWorks\ChangeControl\LOG_KelpWorks_ChangeControl.xlsx (outside OneDrive)
The only file any tool writes. People edit it here in Excel desktop. Close it before Claude Code writes: the tool stops if a ~$ lock file exists.
SharePoint copy
QAQC > KelpWorks ERP > Change_Control > LOG_KelpWorks_ChangeControl.xlsx
READ-ONLY. Refreshed after every tool write and by 'python tools/changelog_write.py --publish' (run it after you edit the master by hand). Read it; never edit it. This is what Claude (chat) reads.
Backups
C:\KelpWorks\ChangeControl\Backups and Change_Control\Backups
One taken before every write, newest 30 kept in each place. '--backups' lists them; '--restore latest' (or a name) puts one back after backing up the current file.
Inbox
Change_Control\Inbox
Where Claude (chat) leaves notes. Applied notes move to processed, rejected ones to rejected, each with a result file. Format: Inbox\README_NOTE_FORMAT.txt and docs/backlog/inbox-note-format.md.
KelpWorks repo
docs/backlog/items.csv and open-decisions.csv
A snapshot Claude Code reads (python tools/export_backlog.py). The workbook is right if they disagree. Procedure for people: docs/sop-change-requests.md.

sections.heading: 2. Column ownership (header colour on Change Log)
rows: Intake - Claude (chat), only through inbox notes
A-M: ID ... Acceptance Criteria; Open Decisions columns A-D; KW plan sheets

Never writes the workbook. Leaves a note (new item, revision, new decision, plan cells); Claude Code applies it with --apply-inbox. New rows get the next free ID from the tool. A revision is accepted only while Status is Not started, Deferred or Blocked (never In progress or On staging; for a Released item raise a new item), must say what changed (appended to Context / Rationale as 'Revised <date> (Claude chat): <what changed>') and is rejected if the item changed since the note was written. If the scope changes while Approved to Start is Y, the human clears it so the item is approved again. Never edits Status, Notes, Claude Code columns or human columns.
Claude Code (blue)
N Status, P Notes, R PR #, S Released Date, V QM-001 Ref

Through python tools/changelog_write.py only. Status: Not started -> In progress -> On staging -> Released, or Blocked. Never sets Deferred / Won't do. Never starts an item unless Approved to Start = Y (or Pre-rule). Released needs a PR # and a Released Date.
Human (orange)
O Owner, Q Approved to Start, T Verified By, U Verified Date; Open Decisions Decided By and Decision

Approves work before it starts. Verifies on live after Released. Sets Deferred / Won't do (Claude Code records the reason in Notes). Answers decisions (Claude Code can record an answer given in chat: --decision).
Every writer (grey)
W Row Updated, X Updated By
Stamped by the tool on every write.
KelpWorks ERP
Read only
Looks up columns by header name; must not write to this file.

sections.heading: 3. Definition of done
rows: Approved
Human
Approved to Start = Y
Released
Claude Code
PR # merged, Released Date, note of what changed, QM-001 ref if a requirement changed
Verified
Human
Checked on live; Verified By + Verified Date. Only now is the change closed (ISO 9001 change control).

sections.heading: 4. Safe-write protocol (done by the tool for every write)
rows: Stops if Excel has the master open (~$ lock file) or another run is writing (.changelog_write.lock). Close the master in Excel before asking for a write.
An open window with AutoSave saves its old copy over newer work.
Reads the file fresh and notes its modified time and checksum.
Never write from a copy read earlier in the session.
Finds rows by ID (KW-xx), never by row number; writes only the cells the writer may write; stamps Row Updated / Updated By.
Limits damage if two writers overlap.
Just before saving, checks the modified time and checksum have not changed; takes a BACKUP (no backup, no write).
Same idea as KelpWorks' edit warning (KW-07); a bad write can always be undone.
About 10 s after saving, re-opens the file and confirms the values stuck, then refreshes the read-only SharePoint copy. A revert is reported, never retried.
The master is outside OneDrive, so a silent revert should not happen; this proves it.
New IDs are allocated only by the tool, from an inbox note (next number after the highest existing ID).
Prevents two KW-61s.

sections.heading: 5. Inbox notes (Claude chat)
rows: new_item
Adds a row (Status Not started, Approved to Start blank).
A required field is missing; Priority or Claude Code Mode is not a value already used; the Change Request is already on the sheet; the note_id was used before.
revision
Changes named intake columns (A-M) of an existing item and appends a 'Revised' line to Context / Rationale.
The item is In progress, On staging, Released or Won't do; the item changed since based_on.Row Updated (stale); no revision_summary; a column that is not an intake column is named.
new_decision
Adds a row to Open Decisions (ID, Decision Needed, Options Discussed, Recommendation).
The ID is not an item; the same ID and question exist; Decided By or Decision is named (a human records those).
plan_cells
Sets named cells on a sheet called 'KW-<number> ... Plan' (cell, was, now).
The sheet name is not a KW plan sheet; a cell's text is not 'was' now (stale); the row does not exist; more than 50 cells.

sections.heading: 6. If something looks wrong
sections.text: Stop writing. Run 'python tools/changelog_write.py --backups', then '--restore <name>' (close Excel first; the current file is backed up before it is replaced), and tell the approver. If the SharePoint copy is older than the master, run '--publish'.
